text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Luminous oil painting of a Chinese-inspired immortal mountain lake, low red-maple canopy framing jade water, stone footbridge to a secluded tiled pavilion, mossy mountains beyond, thick purposeful brushwork, burgundy foliage and dark emerald balanced by gold reflected light, no figurative sculpture.
